_comment: USD per 1M tokens, read from the provider's public price page on the date
in `prices_checked`. They are data because a price change must not silently
invalidate a published cost claim: the harness prints the price and the
date it was read next to every figure, and `eval/answers.py --dry-run`
prices the run before it is paid for.
Adding a model: copy an entry, give it the provider's current rates and
context window, and re-run the dry run. A model missing from this file can
still be measured for accuracy; it just cannot be priced.
gpt-4o-mini is the default because the report's token counts come from
tiktoken's gpt-4o encoder, so its input tokens are counted, not estimated.
